name: Click Beetle
text: Your When played effects trigger twice.
golden_text: Your When played effects trigger three times.
details: Only the strongest Click Beetle counts. Every Bird homecoming also replays its When played effects before homecoming growth. Extra triggers cannot repeat multiplication or advance a countdown.
